Any ideas regarding this please? is this something known? is Retry a feature that has been completed and being widely used with C#? Our first goal of moving to using gRpc is to leverage the Retry feature, if Retry is not ready yet we possibly may need to reconsider the project plan. Much appreciated if any suggestions/details. Thanks a lot!

@jtattermusch, is opening issue here the right approach to request help on issue like this? if no, can you pls let me know what's the right channel to ask question? I'm wondering am I using the retryPolicy right? can you pls take a look if my retryPolicy configuration looks good? Thanks a lot!
@yabli  can you provide minimal reproduction as a ready-to-use project (e.g. as a github repository)?
@jtattermusch, thanks for looking into this. Please find my repro [here ](https://github.com/yabli/grpcTest1). Thanks a lot!
